To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the nrdDG FNR sites, FNR-2 (5'-GTTGAC-3') and FNR-3 (5'-GATGAC-3'), are required to activate transcription of the nrdD gene.

the FNR-dependent activation of the nardDG promoter requires the presence of the upstream FNR box, termed FNR2, and that the downstream FNR box, FNR1, is not essential for anaerobically induced expression of this promoter.
the anaerobic transcriptional activator, FNR, binds to a specific DNA sequence in the nrdDG gene promoter to activate transcription in Escherichia col.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transcriptional regulation of the anaerobically inducible ribonucleotide reduction system.
elucidating how transcriptional regulators control gene expression in response to changing environmental conditions.
the regulation of anaerobic ribo-nucleotide reductases, enzymes that are essential to the synthesis of deoxyribonucleotides, which in turn are required for DNA synthesis.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
anaerobic induction of nrdDG expression requires the FNR-2 box and the FNR- 1 box, and the two sites act in an additive manner.
the anaerobic expression of the nrdD gene is controlled by two FNR sites in the promoter region.
the FNR sites in the nrdDG promoters are required to activate expression of the anaerbic ribonucleotide redutase of Eschericia coli.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the anaerobic nrdDG promoter is activated by FNR in an oxygen-sensitive, FNR-2/FNR-1 dependent manner.
FNR-2 is required for FNR-dependent nrdDG activation and FNR-2/FNR-1 binding is necessary for full activation.
anaerobically expressed nrdDG is controlled by the FNR-dependent FNR-2 box, and that the FNR-2/FNR-1 box pair provides maximal expression in response to low oxygen tension.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FNR-2 box is required for the FNR-dependent activation of the n rdDG promoter, while the FNR-3 site has a positive effect on transcription.
the FNR-2 binding site is the key element in the regulation of nrdDG expression.
the FNR-2 box is the primary FNR site for activation of the n rdDG promoter.
